name: postcard
description: Draws each prompt you send as a blue bordered card, each slash command as a purple one, and /prompts lists them in a pane to search, jump to, re-send or edit; /prompts prev and next step between them.

queue.title: Prompt queue
queue.description: postcard: a prompt you send with ctrl+x enter while Claude works waits in a queue above the prompt, where you can reorder, edit, remove or hold it; the next one is sent when the turn ends, and the queue holds after an interrupt. Enter and send-now (ctrl+x ctrl+s) stay Claude Code's own. Slash commands and prompts with @file mentions or pasted images still go to Claude Code's own queue. engine: Claude Code queues every prompt itself.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons in a terminal with a Nerd Font (3.2 or newer), the Unicode glyphs elsewhere. plain: the Unicode glyphs (✓ ● ━ ╭). text: ASCII stand-ins (v * = +) and classic borders, for a terminal or font that cannot show them. nerd: Nerd Font icons in the terminal even where no Nerd Font was found.
